title: Remove GIF and sticker options from chat composer

requirements.text: Remove the GIF and sticker selection option from the chat composer UI. Delete or disable the MediaPicker component (frontend/src/components/MediaPicker.tsx) and remove any button, tab, or trigger that opens it within ChatRoom.tsx. Ensure no GIF/sticker UI element remains visible in the message input area.

quotes: remove the option of gifs and stickers

acceptanceCriteria: No GIF button or sticker button is visible in the chat composer or anywhere in the chat room UI
The MediaPicker component is no longer rendered or accessible
Removing the GIF/sticker option does not break other media upload features (images, audio, video)
No console errors related to the removed MediaPicker component

constraints: Do not remove or break other media attachment features (image upload, audio recording, video recording/upload)
Do not modify immutable frontend paths
nonGoals: Removing backend support for any media types
Any changes to the room creation or joining flow
